summary: News Corporation filed an 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 disclosing routine daily ASX buy-back reports tied to its previously announced stock repurchase program, which authorizes up to $1 billion in aggregate Class A and Class B common stock. Exhibits 99.1 and 99.2 reproduce the ASX disclosures; no new authorization, price, stake or transaction was announced. Mechanics are open-market repurchases at prevailing prices subject to market conditions, securities laws and alternative investment opportunities. The filing is administrative in nature; no deal terms, board recommendation or advisor are stated. No risk-arb angle applies.
